attempts.name: addpipe16_koggestone
attempts.rationale: The current frontier's best-WNS design is a full parallel-prefix adder labeled '(16,)', but its exact structure is opaque. I implement a canonical 4-stage Kogge-Stone prefix adder, which achieves the theoretically minimal logic depth (ceil(log2(16))=4 stages) for carry propagation, potentially yielding a shorter critical path (higher WNS) than the previously explored hybrid ripple/prefix combos, while area scales predictably with the well-understood KS fan-out structure. Since proxy_reward weights WNS 10x more heavily than area (coefficient -0.001 vs +10), even a modest WNS improvement should dominate any area increase from the extra prefix gates.
